scope: Primary-source UWB/NBA-MMS feasibility research; no phone commands or ranging executed

device.exact_controller: NXP SR200T identified from exact phone config/service metadata

findings.finding: Samsung S25 Ultra specification lists UWB support. Does not identify the UWB controller or firmware.
Current Samsung Wallet matrix includes S25 Ultra/Plus/Edge for UWB Aliro Home Key on Android16 or later. This is service compatibility, not unrestricted controller access or NBA-MMS proof.
Samsung announced Exynos Connect U100 in March2023 with STS, FiRa certification and CCC3.0 support. The announcement does not map U100 to S25 Ultra or state NBA-MMS support.

findings.location: PDF page61 (zero-based60), printed page57; Tu1A-4 June9 2026
findings.finding: Samsung engineers describe an IEEE802.15.4ab NBA-MMS receiver supporting both narrowband and UWB. Establishes Samsung engineering work, not S25 shipment, firmware availability or an ordinary app API.
NXP explicitly advertises IEEE802.15.4ab and 4z compatibility for preproduction automotive NCJ29D8. Does not establish mobile SR200/SR250 NBA-MMS or S25 controller support.
Samsung describes FiRa4.0 features as IEEE802.15.4z based and future 802.15.4ab adoption separately. FiRa certification/version alone cannot establish NBA-MMS support.

Research describes Apple proposed NBA-MMS using narrowband and multi-millisecond ranging fragments, and cites Apple IEEE presentation 15-21-0593. This motivates checking the physical mode separately from FiRa profile/key matching. No claim this paper proves AirPods Pro3 mode.
RANGING_SESSION_RAW gives app-controlled OOB negotiation/parameters. It does not advertise arbitrary RF packets, raw UCI access or NBA-MMS.

Saved source/public API snapshots expose six FiRa profile constants, session/subsession identifiers and keys, complex channel, update rate and slot duration. No vendor bundle, arbitrary UCI payload or NB/MMS fields are exposed in this snapshot. Main snapshot may differ from shipped Samsung code and newest API37 reference.

Binder methods for vendor UCI messages, vendor/OEM callbacks and low-level ranging invoke enforceUwbPrivilegedPermission. Enforcement checks android.permission.UWB_PRIVILEGED before delegating. Reflecting Java classes would not remove this permission check.

Selected public SRXXX UwbApi_Proprietary.h and UwbApi_Types_Proprietary.h and nearby-interaction TLV header contain no NBAMMS/NBA/MMS/narrowband API names in reviewed text. This limited negative observation is not a controller capability verdict; this is an embedded SR250 SDK, not the phone firmware.

findings.location: Report page4 section2.3; pages35-40 BPRF/HPRF plots
findings.finding: Samsung/Element report for A3LSMS938B describes two antennas, BPRF preambles9-12 and HPRF preamble27, with channels5 and9 tested. Phone build tested was S938BXXU0AXHN; this is not an identified UWB controller firmware version. No controller model or NBA-MMS capability is identified in reviewed report text. Compatible conventional channel/PRF coverage is a useful physical prerequisite, not proof of matching the Apple case mode.

findings.location: 2022 Heyden thesis, sections4.4 and5.3-5.4, PDFpages44 and52-53
findings.finding: Historical S21 Ultra SR100T analysis identifies samsung.uwb.jar, com.samsung.android.uwb_extras.jar and sendRawUci. Raw method was permission-restricted to system apps; /dev/sr100 allowed only uwb user/group or root. Useful names for metadata research, not proof of S25 chip/API and not a bypass route.

apple_context.finding: Apple RangeEnableParameters carries distinct FiRa and NBAMMS structures; Hawkeye task selectors include startNBRangingHawkeyeTaskWithIRK. Actual mode chosen for this Pro3 case remains unconfirmed. IRK is not assumed to be a FiRa STS session key.

decision.can_build_now: Read-only metadata/artifact research and offline OOB/profile parser comparisons. Generic FiRa integration has public Android APIs if device supports them.
decision.not_yet_demonstrated: An AirPods case OOB handshake and matched ranging mode that an ordinary S25 Ultra app can configure.
decision.conditional_blocker: Public Android ranging cannot express NBAMMS. Samsung provides a WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS-gated raw UCI endpoint, and that development permission may be granted through authorized ADB. Actual access and controller NBA-MMS support still require evidence; ordinary runtime permission alone is insufficient.

next_read_only_steps: Run simulated probes before Android metadata probe; record actual API/release/OneUI and UWB feature visibility. Termux denial means caller restriction, not missing hardware.

Inspect names, public class/method signatures and permission annotations in world-readable UWB/Samsung framework artifacts only. Look for NBAMMS, NBA, MMS, narrowband, OOB, vendor session configurations and explicit ordinary-app entrypoints. No binder calls or hidden API bypass.
Use any publicly readable, nonsecret vendor capability document or controller/firmware version metadata to establish exact S25 controller; do not infer from other Galaxy models.
Compare Android exposed params with Apple NBA/MMS field families offline. A missing public parameter mapping is an API boundary, not a guessed radio packet format.

If shell/artifact visibility is insufficient, report unknown. A separate ordinary Android app capability query may be considered later only after simulation; this handoff authorizes no APK install/launch or ranging.
limitations: Official Samsung S25 source portal could not be fetched here; unverified community kernel mirrors were not used to identify the controller.
FCC report concerns global SM-S938B tested in 2024; measured phone variant/OneUI9 firmware may differ.
The 2022 thesis uses S21 Ultra, not S25 Ultra.
No Android app capability query or radio session was executed.
